localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group Camp, situated above Hood Canal, in a wooded, primitive setting, accommodates up to 40 people. Number of tents allowed depends on size of tent. Facilities include a vault toilet, 1 large BBQ, 5 fire rings, and a water post on site.
Group camp is a tent area only, no RV/trailers allowed. Maximum of 10 vehicles.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
This site was previously part of a double site. It is very close to site 7 and offers little privacy.

localizedValues.name: Emel House
localizedValues.description:
Vintage 1912 home with quaint country atmosphere. Beautiful setting with garden, expansive lawn, lush landscape, charming gazebo and spectacular view of Hood Canal. The house can accommodate up to 40 guests, and has a combined interior and exterior capacity of up to 75 guests.
Amplified music is only allowed during wedding ceremony. No amplified music such as DJ equipment, stereos, and speakers, including bluetooth, are allowed at any other time.
Closed: Tuesdays and Thursdays
